summary:
This is not to acknowledge your letter because your letter deals with a toilet seat and I do not acknowledge letters dealing with toilet seats, even though it is sage. However, I am writing to you anyhow. Last week Tessa and I got married. Then I got very ill and had to go to the hospital. Also, I sold two (2) novels, both to Doubleday, in the month of April. The first is called, FLOW MY TEARS, THE POLICEMAN SAID. The second is called, A SCANNER DARKLY. Both are the best novel in the world. They have paid me (us) a lot of money and so we are flying back to Vancouver. Or rather I am flying back; Tessa is flying to. Since she has never been before. Since 
we are quite rich, as well as fat, Tessa with child, me with many good meals I expect you will meet us at the airport and record our entire conversation for later replay over CKLG FM or whatever it’s called. 

Our cat Pinky will follow later, disguised as a box of dope, inasmuch as it is not legal to ship cats across the border. If he miaows during the custom check I intend to say, “There is a funny story that goes with that dope,” and hope that 1 can think of one then because I can’t right now. I am now out of the hospital. What I have is high blood pressure and a gall bladder.
